name: waymark
description: A supply chain for your coding agent's work: every task goes through the department that owns it (frontend, backend, data, security, QA, devops, architecture, UX/UI, product, devex), you decide among the optimal options, evidence and gates are checked, and a hash-chained record ties inputs, decision and commits. Stack- and agent-agnostic, layered loading to save tokens, learns with use.
